title: 02 · Union と型の絞り込み
lesson: 合流した型が、分岐で再び絞られる。
source:
# Branches merge into Int32 | String; is_a? narrows the type within a branch.
value = if ARGC_UNSAFE > 1
          42
        else
          "crystal"
        end

if value.is_a?(Int32)
  value + 1
else
  value.size
end

title: 04 · Normalizer の仕事
source:
# Observe how +=, unless, and until are transformed.

x += 2
unless x > 10

end
until x >= 12

end

title: 07 · struct と initialize
lesson: 宣言からインスタンス、そしてメソッドへ。
source:
# Observe the type declaration, initialize, generated new method, and specialization.
struct Point
  getter x : Int32
  getter y : Int32

  def initialize(@x, @y)
  end

  def sum
    @x + @y
  end
end

Point.new(12, 30).sum

title: 09 · Declarations and type hierarchy
lesson: Observe creation, reopening, inheritance and method registration.
source:
# Follow declaration operations in the Declarations tab.
module Named
  def label
    "instance"
  end
end

module FactoryLabel
  def label
    "class"
  end
end

class Parent
end

class Child < Parent
  include Named
  extend FactoryLabel

  def value(x : Int32)
    x
  end

  def self.value(x : Int32)
    x
  end
end

class Child
  def value(x : String)
    x
  end
end

macro make_type(name)
  class {{name.id}}
    def value
      42
    end
  end
end

make_type Generated

puts Child.new.label
puts Child.label
puts Child.new.value(7)
puts Child.value(8)
puts Child.new.value("nine")
puts Generated.new.value

title: 10 · Initializer selection
lesson: Observe replacement, literal-first typing, automatic casts and generic deferral.
source:
LIMIT = 3

class Counters
  @@seed = 1
  @@seed = 7
  @@derived : Int32 = @@seed + 1
  @wide : Int64 = 2

  def value
    @@seed + @@derived + @wide + LIMIT
  end
end

class Deferred(T)
  @value = 1
end

puts Counters.new.value

title: 12 · Type guesses and self
lesson: Follow merged type guesses and the evidence used to collect initialization assignments.
source:
class Guessed
  def initialize
    @value = 1
  end

  def initialize(text : String)
    @value = nil
    kind = self.class
    ignored = self.probe
    @value = 2.5
  end

  def probe
    self
  end

  def value
    @value
  end
end

puts Guessed.new.value
puts Guessed.new("second").value
